description: The RFC 7517 A.3 set by the kid of its HMAC key returns that key; decided by ADR 0054 §2.5 (kid, exact equality): member 0 has no kid, so it never matches a selector with one (§1.2), and member 1's kid is equal; with no alg or key_use nothing else is checked; outcome hand-derived from the ADR 0054 text (conformance/tools/jwk-oracle/specs/select.json), never computed by polyjose

keys.kid: HMAC key used in JWS spec Appendix A.1 example

selector.kid: HMAC key used in JWS spec Appendix A.1 example

jwk.kid: HMAC key used in JWS spec Appendix A.1 example
